title: action-run preflight --json
description: The document action-run preflight --json prints: the check document with an images array and the pull concurrency added.  Objects reject keys this file does not name, so a new key is a schema change.

schema_version.description: The version of this shape; App::Actions::Runner->preflight_schema_version returns it.

ready.description: True only when the checks passed and every image was prepared; a deferred image does not make the run unready.

problems.description: How many problems were found, counting the failed images.

pull_concurrency.description: How many pulls the preflight allowed at once: the configured setting, but 1 on Windows, where images are pulled one at a time.  It is the number the puller was given, not how many pulls happened to overlap.

image.description: The probe image, or null when no container was run.

oneOf.description: The temporary directory the probe reads back from.
The project directory, whose entry count is compared with the host's.

images.description: Every image the selected jobs need, in the order the run would need it.

image.description: The image name, or null when it could not be resolved yet.

source.description: The job, service or action that needs it.

expression.description: Only on a deferred entry: the image name as it was written.

error.description: Only on a failed or deferred entry: why it was not prepared or named.
